quote: HHF was significantly reduced by tirzepatide (n = 2 RCTs), whereas semaglutide (n = 4 RCTs) showed a non-significant trend toward a reduction.
note_section: Key findings relevant to the question

quote: However, the availability of head-to-head comparisons between different OMMs in randomized controlled trials (RCTs) is still limited 19 , which makes assessment of differences in efficacy and safety across available molecules challenging.

The quality of studies was heterogeneous (Supplementary Fig. 2 ). Most of the included RCTs were double blind (66%), with a few trials inadequately reporting attrition and/or description of allocation or blinding of assessors (29%).

sec: Results / Network meta-analysis / Effects on cardiovascular morbidity and mortality
quote: No information on cardiovascular mortality was reported for phentermine plus topiramate.

sec: Results / Network meta-analysis / Effects on quality of life and mental health
quote: Few studies reported on anxiety (n = 9); thus, an NMA was not possible, and low event numbers precluded a formal meta-analysis.
